title: Harbor Pottery Email Runbook
subtitle: DNS → Workspace domains → mailboxes → authentication → warm-up. Amber bars are forced waits; do the next phase while one runs.

phases.title: Point the domains at your DNS host

items.action: Check DNSSEC is off at the registrar, for both domains
items.detail: If it's on, switching nameservers silently breaks resolution.
Domain list → Manage → Nameservers → Custom DNS → paste the two nameservers your DNS host shows.

items.action: Wait for both domains to show Active at the DNS host
Add both domains as secondary domains
items.detail: Account → Domains → Manage domains → Add a domain → secondary. **Not** alias domains: those mirror every user of the primary.
Add the TXT record the console shows at your DNS host, then click Verify.

items.action: Activate Gmail on both, and add the MX record at your DNS host

values.label: MX, each domain
values.text: Type MX   Name @   Server smtp.google.com   Priority 1

items.detail: Same as the steps above: secondary domain, verify, MX. No DKIM if it never sends.
items.confirm: you said you'd decide later. Skip this until you have.

items.text: No DKIM key until 24–72 hours after Gmail is activated. Do Phase 3 while you wait.

values.label: TXT, each domain
values.text: Type TXT   Name @   Value v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all

items.detail: `hello@harborpottery-mail.example`, used for outreach and nothing else.

items.title: Check your edition before planning the booking page.
items.text: Appointment schedules need Business Standard or above; Starter doesn't have them. Billing in the admin console shows your edition. On Starter: upgrade one seat, or use a separate booking tool.

items.action: Generate a DKIM key for each domain
items.detail: Apps → Google Workspace → Gmail → Authenticate email → Generate new record (2048-bit) → add the TXT at your DNS host → **Start authentication**.
Send yourself a test from each domain → Show original → look for `DKIM: PASS` and `SPF: PASS`.

items.text: Let SPF and DKIM settle before adding DMARC.

items.detail: Starts at `p=none` to observe before enforcing.

values.label: TXT, each domain
values.text: Type TXT   Name _dmarc   Value v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@harborpottery.example

items.action: Warm up hello@ by hand for about three weeks
items.detail: Real one-to-one emails to people who reply. No cold sends before then.

footer: harborpottery.example is for customers; harborpottery-mail.example is for outreach only.
